pages.title: Infall Rock
pages.text: Rock stretched and compressed on its way toward a black hole. Its grains are elongated along one axis by tidal forces, and the light from it arrives reddened and slow. It is dense, faintly warm, and seems to lean inward.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Near the horizon, the ground itself is falling. I chipped samples of this spaghettified stone and noticed every crystal pointing the same way: toward the singularity it has been falling into.
